issue.title: Defer: react-native-bootsplash major (+ sharp) upgrade
issue.body:
## Context

Dependabot PR #633 bumps `sharp` (transitive) and ancestor `react-native-bootsplash` together. On current Expo SDK 57, Quality Gates fail `expo install --check` (matrix expects `react-native-bootsplash` `^6.3.10`). This is a **risky native** bump — not a CI-first Dependabot merge.

Prior Dependabot queue left #633 open for the same reason; closing it now so it does not occupy `open-pull-requests-limit: 5`, with this ticket as the tracker.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Evaluate bootsplash major against SDK 57 (or land with SDK 58 per #536)
- [ ] Local `npm ci` → `npm run doctor` → full CI gate + Android smoke (cold start / BootSplash)
- [ ] Consider `dependabot.yml` ignore for `react-native-bootsplash` semver-major until ready

## Refs

- Open bot (will close): https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/633
- Related: #536 (SDK 58)
